scope: MSVC revalidation of the versioned C ABI and its Rust-binding prerequisite

commands.command: set PATH=C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer;%PATH% && call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" && cmake -S native -B native\build-msvc-validation -G "NMake Makefiles" && cmake --build native\build-msvc-validation && ctest --test-dir native\build-msvc-validation --output-on-failure
